page_title: HAV 0-1 PSG | Le Havre v PSG 28/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' The ball is out of play and Le Havre manage to earn a corner.

90+5' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The linesman makes the right call and Le Havre will have a corner.
90+4' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle and signals a foul after Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) brought his opponent down. Le Havre are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
90+2' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
89' Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
87' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Simon Ebonog (Le Havre) was quite harsh and Marc Bollengier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
86' Le Havre are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
84' Substitution. Stephan Zagadou makes his way off the pitch and Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) comes on as his replacement.
84' Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) has tested the patience of referee Marc Bollengier and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
84' Substitution. Ally Samatta (Le Havre) on for Lucas Gourna-Douath.
81' The statistic for corner kicks – 1:3.
79' Penalty saved! Desire Doue (PSG) sends the penalty towards the bottom left corner, but Mory Diaw pulls off a wonderful save to deny him.
79' Desire Doue (PSG) is going to take the penalty!
78' Lucas Gourna-Douath (Le Havre) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. PSG are awarded a penalty!
76' Desire Doue (PSG) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.

74' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Marc Bollengier with no other option than to blow for a foul.
71' Luis Enrique has decided to make a change. Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) replaces Khvicha Kvaratskhelia.
71' Substitution. Kenny Quetant (Le Havre) in, Sofiane Boufal out.
70' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) is put clean through inside the box by Warren Zaire-Emery, but he gets right under the ball and sends it just over the bar. Should have been a goal!

68' Desire Doue (PSG) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
66' A pass into the box finds Bradley Barcola (PSG) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Mory Diaw denies him.
65' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:15.
63' PSG are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yanis Zouaoui trots off the pitch and is replaced by Enzo Koffi Vinette (Le Havre).
61' We are about to witness a substitution. Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) is replacing Timothee Pembele.
61' Luis Enrique prepares a substitution. Kang-In Lee is replaced by Desire Doue (PSG).
61' It is time for a substitution. Nuno Mendes (PSG) is on for Dro Fernandez.
60' An attempted cross from Kang-In Lee (PSG) is cleared.
58' Vitinha (PSG) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
57' One of the players from Le Havre times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
56' 30:70 – the ratio of ball possession.

54' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Matvey Safonov makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
53' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
51' Bradley Barcola (PSG) spurns a big chance! He makes himself some space to meet a cross and from near the penalty spot sends a header well wide of the left post!
50' What a big chance! Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
49' Timothee Pembele (Le Havre) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
47' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' A player from Le Havre commits a rough challenge. Marc Bollengier blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for PSG due to an offside in the build-up play.
42' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Marc Bollengier wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
41' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Dro Fernandez (PSG) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
39' Close! Kang-In Lee (PSG) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
39' The resulting corner from Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) is cleared by the defence.
37' 0 - 1 Simply glorious! Bradley Barcola (PSG) wonderfully timed his run onto a cross and thunders the ball from deep inside the box into the top left corner!
36' A pass from Kang-In Lee (PSG) is intercepted by Mory Diaw and the move breaks down.
33' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 0:7.
31' Timothee Pembele (Le Havre) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
30' That was close! Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) makes a good run into the centre of the box and gets his head onto a lofted pass, but sends the ball a fraction over the bar.
28' Stephan Zagadou (Le Havre) is penalised for holding. Marc Bollengier signals a set piece.
26' PSG are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
24' Kang-In Lee (PSG) meets a precise pass with a nice touch on the edge of the box and produces a shot to the middle of the goal. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper!
22' Ayumu Seko (Le Havre) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
20' PSG are seeing far more of the ball now.
18' Marc Bollengier interrupts the game. One of the players from Le Havre won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
16' The ball possession at the moment is 20:80.
14' A dangerous looking corner kick from Kang-In Lee (PSG) is cleared to safety by the defence.
13' Bradley Barcola (PSG) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. PSG win a corner kick.
11' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
10' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Marc Bollengier has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
9' Mory Diaw (Le Havre) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
7' Handball! A player from Le Havre handled the ball.
5' PSG are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear.
3' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post.
2' The referee awards a corner and Kang-In Lee (PSG) goes over to take it.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
PSG will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Marc Bollengier.
